title: How inheritance works in AeroTopo
answer: A subclass declared with `extends` inherits accessible members from its superclass, can add new state, and can override eligible instance methods. The subclass object still contains and initializes the superclass portion first. AeroTopo's `Orthomosaic extends Product` inherits identity, tiles, export, equality, and hashing behavior, adds `gsd`, and overrides `resolutionMetres()`. `Dem` reuses the same Product abstraction with a different resolution implementation.
